hook_candidates.headline: Google's Gemini app adds a page for business owners
hook_candidates.sub: Announced October 20, 2026. Rolling out worldwide in the coming days.

caption:
You run the business alone, so branding and finance reports land on you. On October 20, 2026, Google announced a new business page inside the Gemini app for small business owners. It rolls out worldwide in the coming days.

What it does, per Google:
• Define your brand once by uploading your website, brand kit, fonts or colors, and Gemini keeps that style for new images.
• Turn messy spreadsheets, receipts and purchase records into clear financial charts.
• Connect apps like Shopify, Canva, Xero, Wix, Dropbox and Google Workspace.

Try this prompt once it reaches your app, with your own spreadsheet attached:
"Turn this spreadsheet into a chart of monthly sales and costs, and tell me which month made the least."

Check the numbers against your books before you act on them.

Source: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-app/new-tools-small-business-owners/
